intro: The severed head of Bazil Thredd serves as definitive proof that the leader behind the Stockade uprising has been eliminated. Demanded by Warden Thelwater, this grim trophy marks an end to the Defias Brotherhood's organized control over Stormwind's subterranean prison.

p: When riots erupted throughout the Stockade beneath Stormwind City, Bazil Thredd quickly established himself as the rebellion's mastermind. Entrenched in his cell block among loyal Defias inmates, Thredd directed the chaos from deep within the dungeon walls. Distrustful of outsiders and struggling to maintain order, Warden Thelwater demanded Thredd's head as unambiguous evidence of his demise and as a test of the adventurer's true allegiance to Stormwind.
